g.text: When may audio start after Start? Network-to-audio handover
Start during Analysing: Busy, nothing cancelled.
Start during Sending: cancels the delivery job.
L2_CONTROL sends no other event during the wait
Seen at the next event check: at most 200 ms later
during a wait; a storage write in progress completes first.
Cancel the operation in progress, once (in-line)
cancel scan, disconnect join, cancel SNTP
or cancel TLS setup/exchange (1 s stop bound)
Stale completions rejected: SNTP, TLS and DNS check the
operation generation; scan results are no longer accepted.
Cleanup pass: one stop try per service still pending (1 s each)
stop setup page (HTTP server); queued requests discarded
Retained, not work: station association and a dormant verified TLS connection.
[A stop failed: latch WIFI_CLEANUP_FAILURE (REQ-13 Wi-Fi-only exception)]
release acknowledged without proof of quiescence
[Release not provable: no acknowledgement within L2_CONTROL's wait]
audio stays stopped; show the reason
Coalescing: L2_COMMUNICATION acts on the latest requested state only.
A Stop before the acknowledgement leaves listening unrequested; a new
Start needs a new acknowledgement. L2_CONTROL serializes Start/Stop with the wait.
